features.title: User and staff authentication
features.authorization: Customer credentials vs staff login; no public Admin registration
notes: Owner superseded memory-only reload behavior on 2026-11-07: persistent HttpOnly same-origin refresh cookies restore web login across reload, tabs and browser restart. Access tokens stay in memory; domain/mobile/API contracts remain Bearer JWT. Exact-origin CSRF and separate customer/staff cookies are required.
Single-flight refresh, at most one replay of a safe request, no refresh loop; logout and account/role changes clear private data.
Signup CredentialsDto has email/password only; optional display name uses authenticated account/profile PATCH after registration.
Forgot/reset/verify flows passed isolated real-backend browser tests, including fragment clearing, replay rejection and password/session revocation. External SMTP delivery is not certified.

Persistent-session browser acceptance: 13 real-backend tests include reload, concurrent tabs, new contexts, cross-tab logout/account switching, CSRF and backend expiry. Cookie max age matches existing 30-day rotating refresh lifetime.

features.title: Catalog navigation, search and product pages
features.authorization: Public ACTIVE-only reads; staff reads, catalog.manage mutations
notes: Live views use canonical UUIDs, scalar English fields, all categoryIds and explicit DRAFT/ACTIVE/ARCHIVED status; runtime sample data and the duplicate UI have been removed.
Backend adds optional currency filter. User price filters target USD with exact minor units; variant prices inherit only when override is null.
Search is server title search; no pretend global SKU/description search. Legacy price presets map to USD caps 25/60/120, stock=1 maps to true, featured maps to visibly labeled newest.
Live product metadata/detail requests are no-store and use actual slugs. Product routes use canonical API slugs.
Source implemented; unit/API/browser test code prepared but execution deferred to step 8 under owner policy.

features.title: Verified uploads, product galleries and reusable assets
features.authorization: Current catalog.manage media guard; deletion/reference rules remain server-side
notes: Bounded GET /v1/admin/media is current-namespace scoped, ACTIVE by default, exact UUID search with page/limit/status. No original filenames exist to search.
Library and product gallery use verified canonical asset IDs. Signed POST/PUT transfers never carry API bearer/cookies; completion remains server verification.
Gallery supports ordered cover, alt text, reuse and reference-safe deletion scheduling. Deletion jobs/provider workers and content/settings integration remain with their owning operations steps.
Media rights remain catalog.manage. Read-only staff cannot upload or use the protected library.
Source and regression tests prepared; no new HTTP/provider/browser execution under deferred-validation policy.

features.title: Physical stock, reservations and adjustments
features.authorization: All existing staff may read balances/movements; inventory.adjust is required for threshold/adjustment writes.
notes: Use InventoryBalance ID, not product ID, as adjustment identity. Physical, reserved and available quantities are separate.
No stock writes through product edits; product/variant stock fields are initial-creation values or read mirrors.
A mutation request keeps the same idempotency UUID across a retry, then refetches authoritative state.

Unconfirmed adjustments keep a locked payload and request UUID for explicit retry/reconciliation; dialog close is blocked until confirmed or locally discarded. No global inventory totals are fabricated from one page.

features.title: Customer profile and addresses
features.authorization: Customer-owned identity; current email/role are not editable profile fields
notes: Live account overview reads the owned profile and edits displayName only. Email/role are not editable; existing verification/password security flows remain separate.
Owned saved-address CRUD/default selection follows Backend max10, ISO country and E.164 rules. Existing default cannot be silently unset; deletion/default replacement is server-confirmed.
Notification preferences remain with the messaging delivery in step 7. No addresses are copied to staff customer views.
New UI tests are prepared; execution is deferred to the final integration window.

features.title: Browser-local guest and customer carts
features.authorization: Browser-local per-customer/guest storage. Customer JWT required for checkout and wishlist.
notes: Provider-scoped Zustand store persists display previews and canonical product/variant IDs with quantities in browser localStorage. Add, manual quantity entry, plus/minus, removal and clear make zero cart requests.
Guest and each customer have separate browser storage keys. Guest items merge explicitly after sign-in. Browser Web Locks serialize same-device mutations and storage events refresh other tabs.

Cart and GuestCart APIs, capability bridge and Prisma tables are retired. Migration drops old saved carts and cart_id references while preserving orders, reservations, payments and reserved inventory allocations.
Stock validation and guarded atomic reservation occur at final checkout. Display prices are recalculated from catalog data on the server. Wishlist remains customer API-backed.
Live database migration applied on 2026-11-14. Updated frontend/backend application deployment remains pending. Browser-local carts do not synchronize across devices.

features.title: Owned wishlist
actions: sign in with safe return to product
features.authorization: Customer-owned Bearer JWT
notes: Web saved items require customer login. Anonymous Save links return to the product after sign-in/signup; no unauthenticated local wishlist or implicit import is introduced.
Saved state changes only after a confirmed PUT/DELETE, then server-owned data is refreshed. Unpublished products stay hidden according to existing Backend rules.
The bounded canonical merge API remains available to other clients/explicit reviewed imports; this web flow has no local guest wishlist to import and never imports legacy fixture IDs.
Private list/counters reset across logout/account changes. Source test execution remains deferred.

features.title: Staff customer directory and detail
features.authorization: customers.view; financial customer reports additionally require payments.view
notes: Live read-only directory uses Backend email/display-name search, ACTIVE/DISABLED filters and pagination.
Details show server order count, up to five recent UUID order statuses and saved-address count. No address contents, location, browser-derived spend or customer mutation controls.
Current customers.view is enforced in navigation and Backend. Financial reporting remains its own permission-gated reporting step.
Browser privacy/ownership and directory tests are prepared, not executed.

features.title: Delivery quote, stock holds and unpaid order creation
features.authorization: Customer JWT; checkout rate and delivery-zone policies OWNER only
notes: Missing or disabled country delivery overrides use a currency default and fall back to zero delivery charges when no default exists. New checkout tax is zero. Country/default taxBps configuration fields are retired. Legacy financial taxMinor values remain part of stored order/reservation snapshots.

Checkout requests contain items [{id,productId,variantId,quantity}]. Delivery options now use POST with the submitted items and destination/coupon. Draft delivery estimates omit inventory joins. Final reservation fingerprints freeze sorted selections and checkout policy. Customer row locks replace cart row locks.

Final boundary POST /v1/checkout/start freezes requestId, country/service/coupon and shippingAddress, locks inventory balances in order, returns structured INSUFFICIENT_STOCK items or reserves stock and creates one order/Stripe TEST Checkout Session. Resume/cancel/reconcile live under /v1/checkout/orders/:orderId. Suggested quantity/removal actions require user choice. Delivery estimates select display data. Payment confirmation uses signed success receipts plus verified provider totals.
Guest cart is supported, guest checkout is not. Require login before checkout and merge safely.
Estimate -> reservation -> order must preserve chosen address/country/service/coupon and request IDs; expire/requote on conflicts.
Order creation is mapped separately by orders feature; do not send client totals or set PAID from a redirect.

Step 5 source implemented; full runtime validation deferred. Owned no-store recovery discovers a live hold/latest unpaid order after reload or lost acknowledgement. Separate frozen request UUIDs, exact server totals and address snapshot allowlist; no browser-storage PII. See WEB_CHECKOUT.md.

features.title: Customer history and staff fulfillment
features.authorization: Customer ownership; orders.manage for staff actions
notes: Live order lists use existing server page/limit and exact UUID lookup; global text/status/date/customer filters are explicitly unavailable, with no fake single-page global filtering.
Order payment status and shipment fulfillment status are independent; UI Pending/Processing/Shipped/Delivered is not a reversible map to Order.status.
One shipment/all lines only in approved v1; no split shipping. Paid refunds are separate from unpaid cancellation.
Dedicated return/replacement/tracking actions are assigned to their own features.

Step 6 source connects owned history/detail/unpaid cancellation and staff one-shipment fulfillment. Typed customer/Admin page/detail schemas mirror existing projections; financial and physical states remain distinct. Full tests deferred.

features.title: Owned TEST payment preparation and safe payment state
features.authorization: Customer-owned payment APIs; refunds OWNER; reporting payments.view
notes: Current provider is STRIPE_TEST only; prepare never returns client_secret. Do not wire a real card/Stripe Elements form or claim production charging from current endpoints.
Existing test-complete is fixed TEST capability and must be clearly gated. Actual provider verification remains separate.
Webhook is backend-only signed input, never a browser action. Refund POST creates a request, not proof of a successful refund.
Admin simulated payment statuses/country search and finance totals must be replaced by the real attempt/collection/refund projections.

Step 5 source connects explicit TEST preparation/completion and owned status refresh, plus paginated permission-gated attempt/collection records. Only server order PAID confirms payment. Real provider/webhook evidence and full reports remain separate.

features.title: Returns, same-SKU replacements and owned tracking
features.authorization: Customer return initiation/ownership; orders.manage inspection/fulfillment; OWNER refund requests
notes: Admin preview requestReturn has no staff return-initiation API: move initiation to the customer flow instead of impersonating a customer.
Return approval, inspection and restock are separate. Refunding never implies stock return. Replacement is same-SKU only; cross-SKU exchange is post-v1.
Tracking is authenticated own UUID-based lookup; do not introduce public email/order-number tracking from the fixture UI.
No direct generic status setter, manual paid flag or local successful-refund record is allowed.

Step 6 source implements customer requests/withdrawal, staff approval/rejection/inspection/restock, inspected same-SKU replacement lifecycle, owned tracking and OWNER-only refund approval/history. Frozen UUID/body explicit retry/reconciliation; no provider execution, local success or stock-by-refund inference. Full validation deferred.

features.title: Staff lifecycle, fresh grants and immutable OWNER

notes: UI display roles map explicitly to persistent uppercase role keys. Never authorize from browser seedRolePermissions.
Staff create requires a password, absent from the current preview form. Keep it write-only and out of persisted state.
UI removeStaff maps to permitted disable/status update; backend has no physical staff-delete route.

OWNER roster/create/write-only initial password, persisted role/grants and disable/status forms implemented. OWNER immutable; no local deletion or browser permissions authority. Full validation deferred.

features.title: Permission-aware financial reports, dashboard and audit
features.authorization: Fresh per-report grants; dashboard.view alone does not grant finance/customer/inventory access
notes: Use verified TEST collection facts and independently confirmed refunds, not order fulfillment-derived revenue or local arithmetic.
Report aggregate minor-unit strings remain exact; no Number conversion/FX/profit inference. Inventory is a current snapshot; financial windows are UTC [from,to).
UI inclusive end date maps to next UTC day. CSV is server-generated, max 1000 rows/5 MiB; surface narrowing errors.
Payment attempt states and derived collection/refund states are separate; do not invent a provider-failed state for an unverified attempt.

Permission-aware server dashboard/reports/audit and bounded authenticated CSV source implemented. Exact integer strings, currency groups, UTC windows and current inventory basis retained; no browser finance totals. Full validation deferred.
